issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a constructor that initializes all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order, and the solution implements a five-parameter constructor. The template, however, provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This constructor parameter mismatch can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and order, and forces them to change the provided stub rather than implement the intended constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture.java to provide a constructor with all five parameters in the same order as the UML and problem description: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Alternatively, replace the existing three-parameter stub with a TODO stub having the correct five-parameter signature so students implement the intended constructor directly.
